title: 第一百章 无中生有
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

青云宗，死了。

不是比喻，而是事实。

从高空俯瞰，这座绵延千里的修仙圣地，已经变成了一片巨大的、暗金色的焦土。灵脉被抽干，山峰被削平，所有的建筑、阵法、传承，都化作了那团悬浮在半空中的、暗金色星云的一部分养料。

玄的身影，重新凝聚成形。不再是之前的星云状，而是一个更加清晰、更加完美、散发着令人窒息威压的人形轮廓。他周身流转着暗金色的光芒，每一寸肌肤，都仿佛由最纯净的庚金之气铸就，不染一丝尘埃。

他低头，俯瞰着脚下这片死寂的大地。

“蝼蚁之巢，不过如此。”

他的声音，冰冷而漠然，再无一丝波澜。对他而言，青云宗就像是一窝蚂蚁，随手碾碎，便再无价值。

他抬起手，看着自己这新生的、完美的手掌。力量，前所未有的强大。这具肉身，已经无限接近他当年全盛时期的圣体。只需再花些时日，彻底炼化这青云宗的底蕴，他便能彻底恢复，甚至更进一步，重返金族，清算当年的背叛。

至于那粒逃入“无”中之物……

玄的眼中，闪过一丝不屑。

那是什么？一粒尘埃？一个念头？还是一缕残魂？

不重要。

那东西，太弱小，太干净，干净到对他这种充满了杀戮和毁灭意志的圣子来说，毫无价值。就像是人类不会去在意脚下的一粒沙子，玄也不会去在意那粒微不足道的“初心”。

他甚至懒得去探查那片“无”到底是什么。

那只是这片空间的一个……漏洞。一个毫无意义的、连法则都不存在的空洞。任何东西掉进去，都只会永恒的消亡，化为虚无。

他收回目光，准备离开。

就在这时，他忽然“看”到了地面上，那两条渺小的、还在挣扎的虫子。

林秋和王虎。

他们的肉身已死，灵魂正被那股法则之力牵引着，飞向玄的掌心。

林秋的灵魂，已经彻底麻木，如同死水。王虎的灵魂，却依旧在咆哮，在怒吼，充满了不甘。

玄的目光，在他们身上停留了一瞬。

“尚有反抗之意，虽蝼蚁般可笑，却也可怜。”

他伸出一根手指，隔空一点。

两道微弱的灵魂光点，瞬间脱离了法则之流的牵引，被他摄到了掌心。

“本座便赐你们，一个永恒服役的机会。”

玄的指尖，弹出两道暗金色的符文，分别打入林秋和王虎的灵魂深处。

“从今往后，汝等为吾之‘金卫’，永世守护圣体，直至宇宙终结。”

林秋和王虎的灵魂，发出无声的惨叫。他们的意识，被那股强大的符文力量，强行抹去、重塑。原本属于“林秋”和“王虎”的情感、记忆、自我，被一点点剥离、粉碎。

取而代之的，是一种冰冷、空洞、只对玄绝对服从的“指令”。

他们的灵魂，渐渐染上了和玄一样的暗金色，变得坚硬、冰冷，如同两尊微缩的金属雕像。

“拜见圣子。”

两尊金卫，单膝跪地，声音整齐划一，毫无感情。

玄微微颔首，不再停留，一步踏出，身影便消失在了虚空之中。他要去寻找下一个猎物，下一个能助他恢复巅峰的“蝼蚁之巢”。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Qingyun Sect is dead.

Not a metaphor, but a fact.

Viewed from a high altitude, this holy land for cultivating immortals that stretches thousands of miles has turned into a huge, dark golden scorched earth.The spiritual veins were drained, the mountain peaks were flattened, and all the buildings, formations, and inheritances were turned into part of the nourishment for the dark golden nebula suspended in mid-air.

Xuan's figure condensed and took shape again.It is no longer the nebula shape before, but a clearer, more perfect humanoid outline that exudes suffocating coercion.Dark golden light flowed all over his body, and every inch of his skin seemed to be made of the purest Gengjin energy, without a trace of dust.

He lowered his head and looked down at the dead land beneath his feet.

"A nest of ants, nothing more than that."

His voice was cold and indifferent, without any waves.To him, Qingyun Sect is like a nest of ants, which can be crushed easily and become worthless.

He raised his hand and looked at his new, perfect palm.Power, unprecedentedly powerful.This body is already infinitely close to the holy body he had during his heyday.As long as he spends some more time to completely refine the foundation of Qingyun Sect, he can fully recover, and even go one step further, return to the Jin Clan and settle the betrayal of the past.

As for the particle that escapes into nothingness...

A trace of disdain flashed in Xuan's eyes.

What is that?A speck of dust?A thought?Or a remnant soul?

unimportant.

That thing was too weak, too clean, so clean that it was worthless to a Holy Son like him who was full of the will to kill and destroy.Just like humans don't care about a grain of sand under their feet, Xuan doesn't care about that insignificant grain of "original intention."

He didn't even bother to find out what that "nothing" was.

That's just a... hole in this space.A meaningless void that doesn't even exist.Anything that falls into it will only perish forever and turn into nothingness.

He withdrew his gaze and prepared to leave.

At this moment, he suddenly "saw" the two tiny, struggling insects on the ground.

Lin Qiu and Wang Hu.

Their bodies are dead, and their souls are being pulled by the power of law, flying towards Xuan's palm.

Lin Qiu's soul was completely numb, like stagnant water.Wang Hu's soul was still roaring and roaring, full of unwillingness.

Xuan's eyes stayed on them for a moment.

"There is still a sense of resistance. Although it is ridiculous like an ant, it is also pitiful."

He stretched out a finger and held it slightly apart.

Two weak soul light spots instantly escaped the pull of the flow of law and were captured in his palm.

"I will give you an opportunity to serve forever."

From Xuan's fingertips, two dark golden runes popped out and penetrated into the souls of Lin Qiu and Wang Hu respectively.

"From now on, you will be my 'Golden Guards', guarding the Holy Body forever until the end of the universe."

The souls of Lin Qiu and Wang Hu screamed silently.Their consciousness was forcibly erased and reshaped by the powerful runic power.The emotions, memories, and selves that originally belonged to "Lin Qiu" and "Wang Hu" were stripped away and shattered bit by bit.

Instead, there was a cold, empty "instruction" that was only obeyed by Xuan.

Their souls gradually became dyed the same dark gold as Xuan, becoming hard and cold, like two miniature metal statues.

"Meet the Holy Son."

The two golden guards knelt on one knee, their voices uniform and emotionless.

Xuan nodded slightly, no longer staying, took one step, and the figure disappeared into the void.He is going to find the next prey, the next "ant's nest" that can help him return to his peak.
